title: CSV line split
statementMd:
Split one CSV line into fields: commas separate fields, fields may be wrapped in double quotes (then they may contain commas, and `""` inside quotes is one literal quote). Return the list of field strings.

**Example:** `split_csv("a,b,c")` returns `["a", "b", "c"]`.
hints: Walk the characters with an `in_quotes` flag.
